complete_files: complete a partial file path by listing matching files in the directory
get_matches_config: get completion matches for config keys and values from an OmegaConf Container
query_config_groups: query Hydra config group options and suggest completions for group names or config overrides
get_filename: parse a command line word to extract a key equals prefix and file path for completion
strip_python_or_app_name: strip the python interpreter or app name from a shell completion command line
